objective: Define a computable scaffold for RT formation from admissibility-bounded relational comparison blocks.
summary: Introduced the RT Relational Mechanics Computational Scaffold to the formal framework. The scaffold rigorously defines RT_candidate generation through admissibility-bounded blocks (delta_a) under typed relational coupling (<*>_x). It establishes distinction-bearing generative paths (D_expr), polarity preservation requirements, and failure modes explicitly preventing identity collapse or projection-only equivalences. The rules were integrated into the living textbook (Formal Candidate 1.2.2C.12), and the associated operators and claims were securely registered at the C1_DEFINED_PROVISIONAL level.
